questions.heading: The Bucket Keeps History: Versioning, No Public Access, prevent_destroy
questions.stem: A colleague deletes the aws_s3_bucket_versioning block from main.tf. The aws_s3_bucket block, with prevent_destroy, is untouched. What does the lesson say happens?

options.text: prevent_destroy stops the plan, because it guards the bucket and every resource attached to it
options.says: The lesson: prevent_destroy on the bucket would not have caught this; the bucket is not destroyed.

options.text: The plan replaces the bucket itself, which prevent_destroy refuses before any change is made
options.says: Only the versioning resource is destroyed; the sample plan shows the bucket untouched.

options.text: The plan destroys the versioning resource, which suspends versioning; the plan check blocks it
options.says: Right: the provider says destroying it suspends versioning; plan_review printed 'destroy <- blocked'.

options.text: The plan destroys the versioning resource, and apply fails, because AWS forbids suspending it
options.says: The provider's documentation says destroying the resource suspends versioning; nothing forbids it.

questions.heading: Each Role Gets Only What Its Part Needs
questions.stem: Because of a bug, the solve worker tries s3:PutObject on a key under snapshots/. Its role has the lesson's solve-job-policy.json. What does the lesson's check of that policy say?

options.text: Denied: the job may write only in results/, and may read only in snapshots/
Allowed: s3:PutObject is in the policy, and an action is granted on every key of the bucket
options.says: Each statement names its own resources: PutObject only on results/*; the output shows the snapshot write denied.

options.text: Allowed: the job reads snapshots, and leave to read a key includes leave to write it
options.says: GetObject and PutObject are separate actions; the output shows the snapshot write denied.

options.text: Denied: the job role holds no S3 permissions, as Fargate's execution role makes the S3 calls
options.says: The execution role pulls the image and writes logs; the job role reads snapshots and writes results.

questions.heading: A Plan Is Data: Stop the Ones That Destroy History
questions.stem: A plan's resource_changes has aws_batch_compute_environment.fargate with the actions ["delete", "create"]. What does the lesson's plan_review do with it?

options.text: Blocks it, because every replacement destroys a resource before it creates the new one in its place
options.says: The output shows 'replace (destroy first)' without a block; only types that hold history are blocked.

options.text: Lets it pass: a compute environment holds no data, and only types holding history are blocked
options.says: Right: KEEPS_HISTORY is the bucket, its versioning and the registry; 'Replacing the compute environment passes'.

options.text: Lets it pass, because a pair of delete and create is read as a single update made in place
options.says: plan_review reads it as 'replace (destroy first)', not an update in place.

options.text: Blocks it, because prevent_destroy is set on every resource that the stack's main.tf declares
options.says: Only the bucket has prevent_destroy in the lesson's main.tf.
